% Pattern: number/equation. \let\c@equation\c@thm makes the equations step the
% counter of the theorems, and the showonlyrefs option of mathtools numbers only
% the equations that an \eqref cites, so the cited equation is 1.2, the others
% take no number, and the second theorem is 1.3. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want thm-2 statement/theorem 1.3
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage[showonlyrefs]{mathtools}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}[section]
\makeatletter
\let\c@equation\c@thm
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{thm} Every compact space is fine. \end{thm}
\begin{equation}
a = b \label{eq:one}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
c = d \label{eq:two}
\end{equation}
\begin{align}
e &= f \\
g &= h
\end{align}
By \eqref{eq:one} the claim holds.
\begin{thm} Every fine space is compact. \end{thm}
\end{document}
